discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its development into therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has already won the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough and Gairdner prizes. It goes from basic peptide endocrinology to semaglutide-class drugs that are changing the treatment of diabetes, obesity and cardiometabolic disease. It also has not overlapped with the recent immunology and RNA awards (2023 to 2025), which makes it the most mature pending candidate.
